content: Paul dunganka townbu Rome courtcasemunku.
Yala-yalabi maja Festus yinyaymba bubungu kadan. Nyulu townbu Caesarea warngku kulur bundan, yinyamun nyulu townbu Jerusalem dungan.
Yinyaymba jana maja-majangka priestangka, and maja-majangka Jew-warrandamundu Paul nyuyan baja miyilba Festusanda.
Jana Festusanda babajin, “Yundu Paul yaluy Jerusalem yungangarr? Nganjin nyungun wawu-yimbanka nganjinandamunbu courtcasemunbu.” Yamba jana jurrilman, nyungun yarkinkaku kuninka baralba.
Festusangka yalaman, “Paul jailba townbu Caesarea. Ngayu juma yinyaymba dungay.
Yurranga maja-maja ngaykunji kadarika, townbu Caesarea. Nyulu townbu Caesarea courtcase haveim-bungal. Yurra yinyaymba nyungun nyuya.”

Yala, Festus townbu Jerusalem warngku 9-bala bundan. Yinyamun nyulu townbu Caesarea dungan baja. Warngku yindu nyulu majandamunbu chairmunbu bundan courtroommunbu. Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Paul wundi.”
Paul walan, jana Jew-warra Jerusalemka nyungundu murumarin. Jana nyungun nyuyan baja, nyuyan baja, yamba jana kari manubajabuku balkan Paulunku. Jana murruji nyungun malaji-bungan.

Paul dakan, nyungunkuku balkan. Nyulu yalaman, “Ngayu kari buyun balkan. Ngayu Jew-warramu ngujakuraku law kari dumbarrin. Ngayu Jew-warramu church yalbay kari buyun-daman. Ngayu kari kuli balkajin kinganka townbu Rome.”
Festus Jew-warranka kurrbarmanka. Yinyayinka nyulu Paulundu babajin, “Yundu townbu Jerusalem kukuku dunganka, courtcasemunku? Ngayu Jew-warramu kuku yinyaymba nyajil yununku.”
Paulungku yalaman, “Ngayu kingandamunbu courtroommunbu janjanay. Ngayu yalaymbaku courtcasemunbu haveim-bunga, townbu Jerusalem kari. Ngayu Jew-warranda kari kuli dajin. Yundu yinyayinka binal.

Kaki ngayu buyun-damanyaku, yalada, ngayu wulayarrku. Kaki jananga kuku ngaykunku manubaja kari, bamangka nganya murruji jananda mambarril townbu Jerusalem. Ngayu kinganda townbu Rome dunganka courtcasemunku.”
Festusangka yinya kuku nyajin, nyulu maja-majanji yindu-yinduynji balkawan. Yinyamun nyulu Paulundu yalaman, “Yundu kinganda dunganka, yalada, kinganda yundu dungayarrku.”
Paul bulanda jakalba, Agrippanda, Berniceanda.
Juma king yindu, burri Agrippa, bula jalbu, burri Bernice townbu Caesarea kadan, Festusanda.
Bula nyungunji bundan warngku kulur. Festusangka Agrippanda balkan Paulunku. Nyulu yalaman, “Felixangka nyubun dingkar jailba bawan nyulu dunganjiku.
Ngayu townbu Jerusalem dungan, jana Jew-warrangka binga-bingangka, priest-priestangka nyungun nyuyan buyun-buyunku. Jana ngaykundu babajin, ‘Yundu nyungu kuli daya, nyungun yarkinkaku kuni.’

Ngayu jananda yalaman, ‘Maja-majangka Roman-warrandamundu kari prisoner-prisoner dajil bamanda jananin nyuyanyamunbu. Kaki bamangka prisoner nyuyal, maja-majangka nyungun courtcasemunbu wundil, nyungu chance dajil nyungunkuku balkanka. Nganjin prisoner kari dajil bamanda yinyarrinyanda nyuyanyamunbu.’
Jana Jew-warra yalaymba kadarin, ngayu jinbalku Paul wundin kukuku.
Balu nyungun nyuyanka buyun-buyunku jirraynka.
Kari, bubanku, jana nyungun nyuyan janandamunku kukuku ngujakuramunku. Jana balkan dingkaranka burri Jesus. Jana yalaman, ‘Nyulu wulan.’ Yamba Paulungku yalaman, ‘Jesus juranku.’
Ngayu binal kari, wanjarrmanka baja. Yinyaynka ngayu Paulundu babajin, ‘Yundu townbu Jerusalem dunganka courtcasemunku?’
Yamba Paulungku balkan nyulu kinganda townbu Romeku courtcasemunku dunganka. Yinyamun ngayu nyungun jailba nandan baja, miyil-kujil-kujin. Ngayu nyungun juma kinganda yunganka.”
Agrippangka Festusanda yalaman, “Ngayu ngayuku yinya dingkar nyajinka.” Festusangka yalaman, “Juma yundu nyungun wunkunku nyajilkuda.”

Warngku yindu Agrippangka bula Berniceangka kambi flash-bala didan. Bula bayanba courtcasemunku walan soldier-soldierandamunji maja-majanji, and council-councilanji townmunku yinyaymbarrku. Jana wubulku kadarin, Festusangka yalaman, “Paul yaluy wundi.” Jana nyungun wundin.

Festusangka yalaman, “King Agrippa, and yurra wubulku, yurra yanyu dingkar nyaka. Jana Jew-warrangka yalaymba, and townbu Jerusalem bundandanya, jana wubulinjaku nyungun nyuyan ngaykundu. Jana yirrkan baja, yirrkan baja, ‘Nyungun yarkinkaku kuni, kunirrku.’
Yamba nganjin nyungun kari kuni, nyulu malaji kari. Nyulu ngaykundu babajin, ‘Yundu nganya kinganda yungangarr.’ Yinyaynka ngayu nyungundu yalaman, ‘Ngayu yungalkuda.’

Yamba ngayu kuku wanyu kinganda yungal Paulunku? Ngayu binal kari wanyurrinku baja jana nyungun nyuyal-nyuyal. Yinyayinka ngayu nyungun yalaymba wundin yurranda. Yundu nyungu kuku nyaka, King Agrippa, ngayu nguba binalmalda. Yinyamun ngayu kabanba balkal kinganda townbu Rome wanyurrimbu ngayu nyungun yungal-yungal.
Kaki ngayu prisoner kinganda yungal, ngayu kari wumbabuku yungal. Ngayu nyungundu balkanka wanyurrinku ngayu yungal.”
